name: Lífe
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: a goddess of the River Liffey
died giving birth at Port Agmar in Aran
a sweet, pleasant woman in the old poems

text: Lífe is the goddess of the River Liffey of Ireland. The old poems called her a sweet, busy, pleasant woman. She died in childbirth at a place called Port Agmar in Aran. Her lord died of grief for her, who loved her well.

okr.objective: Tell the tale of the goddess Lífe and the river Liffey.
